dimension_evidence.diagnosis: A correct diagnosis must distinguish ordinary operator and higher-order-operator targets from plain callable targets present in vectorized pre-dispatch graphs, understand their input/output encoding contract, and preserve executable target identity across the round trip. The observed error identifies an unsupported target but does not itself determine the symmetric encoding/decoding repair.
dimension_evidence.localization: The public feature name and a natural serialization exception narrow the search to the torch.export serde component, so this is not a cross-repository or broad backend localization problem. It still does not expose a file or symbol, and a complete repair must find the corresponding serialization and deserialization execution paths.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: A valid repair must implement compatible handling in both serialization and deserialization, choose the appropriate higher-order input/output representation, and avoid weakening ordinary ExportedProgram value and requires-grad compatibility. Plausible one-sided or overly broad fixes can make save succeed while load or execution still fails, so the repair is not a unique mechanical replacement.
